---


Added a Types filter to the Wheel page.

**Features:**
- **Type badges**: Shows all available place types (cafe, restaurant, etc.) as clickable badges
- **Filtering**: Click badges to toggle types; the list shows places matching at least one selected type
- **Visual feedback**: Selected types use the default badge style; unselected use outline
- **Clear filters**: Button appears when filters are active
- **Empty state**: Shows a message when no places match the filters

The filter appears above the places list. Selected types persist while browsing, and the wheel works with the filtered results. Types are formatted (underscores replaced with spaces) for readability.
